AISIN Automotive Ltda. in Brazil and others make and sell automotive parts. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥39,461 million, segment profit was ¥4,244 million and the number of employees was 819.
entries.6a7d2ce8bc105614: A company that makes automotive parts such as automatic transmissions and brakes and supplies them to automakers worldwide, centered on the [[company:toyota|Toyota Motor]] group.
entries.9d255607377f877b: The business in Europe. AISIN Europe S.A. in Belgium handles sales, and AISIN Europe Manufacturing Czech s.r.o. makes automotive parts locally. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥268,672 million, segment profit was ¥4,123 million and the number of employees was 2,274; it is the smallest region among the 5 reportable segments. The company explains that revenue decreased because of lower sales volume of automatic transmissions, and that profit decreased despite one-time income.

entries.c888402d42bcbf9d: Operations in Japan. AISIN CORPORATION and subsidiaries such as ADVICS CO., LTD., Aisin Takaoka Co., Ltd., Aisin Shiroki Co., Ltd., Aisin Kiko Co., Ltd. and Aisin Kyushu Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell automotive parts and energy solution-related equipment. Because parts made in Japan are also shipped to overseas affiliated companies, in the fiscal year ended March 2026 there were inter-segment internal revenues of ¥696,682 million against revenue from external customers of ¥2,518,054 million. Segment profit was ¥80,257 million and the number of employees was 63,954, making it the largest region among the 5 reportable segments. The company explains that revenue increased owing to higher sales volumes of hybrid transmissions and eAxles, and that profit increased owing to the results of efforts to improve the corporate structure, despite investment in people and the future. The group's major customer overall is [[company:toyota|Toyota Motor]] Corporation and its group companies, which record revenue in all reportable segments; their revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,112,449 million.
entries.df257b1644fb87c5: Power sliding door systems and sunroofs
entries.f5d1794652b6174f: The business in Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, India and other countries. AISIN Powertrain (Thailand) Co., Ltd., AISIN Thai Automotive Casting Co., Ltd., AISIN Indonesia Automotive Co., Ltd., AT Indonesia Co., Ltd., Toyota AISIN Philippines, Inc., AISIN Automotive Haryana Private Limited (India) and others make and sell automotive parts. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥544,258 million, segment profit was ¥69,618 million, the second largest after Japan, and the number of employees was 17,599. The company explains that revenue and profit increased because of higher vehicle production volume at customers and higher sales volume of powertrain units, in addition to the continued trend of a weaker yen.
entries.f6a3a9a7f9ee83b7: The business in the People's Republic of China. Overseen by AISIN (China) Investment Co., Ltd. (Shanghai), Tianjin AISIN Automatic Transmission Co., Ltd., GAC AISIN Automatic Transmission Co., Ltd. (Guangzhou), Zhejiang Geely AISIN Automatic Transmission Co., Ltd. (Ningbo), AISIN Tangshan Gear Co., Ltd., AISIN Suzhou Automotive Parts Co., Ltd. and others make and sell automotive parts. GAC AISIN and Zhejiang Geely AISIN are automatic transmission companies formed as joint ventures with local automakers. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥566,074 million, segment profit was ¥30,657 million and the number of employees was 13,020. The company explains that revenue decreased because of lower sales volume of automatic transmissions, and that profit decreased also because of one-time costs such as structural reform expenses.
